OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: First select 1 eligible Gu Worm, then select up to 3 additional Gu Worms. Each refinement has 4 slots: a mortal Gu Worm takes 1 slot and an immortal Gu Worm takes 2 slots, so you can refine up to 4 mortal or 2 immortal Gu Worms (e.g. 1 immortal + 2 mortal). Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Select the first Gu Worm to refine. Then select up to 3 more Gu Worms; each mortal takes 1 slot and each immortal takes 2 slots, 4 slots in total.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: First select a currently craftable Gu card, then select Gu Worm materials matching that target. Materials are consumed and the result is created only when both types and quantities match; failed attempts do not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Select materials matching the target Gu card, then confirm.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.targetSelecti: First select the Gu card to craft. Only materials that can match the target will be shown next.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.secondMort: Select additional Gu Worms to refine (mortal takes 1 slot each, immortal takes 2 slots each, 4 slots total), or confirm with 0 selected.
